o.text: Internationalism; ultimately from Ancient Greek πρόβλημα (próblēma).
Borrowed from Arabic ضِدِّيَّة (ḍiddiyya). By surface analysis, zidd + -iyyət.
From söy- + -gü. Compare development of /œj/ from /ev/ in dialectal ev (“house”) → öy, neft (“oil”) → nöyüt.
Borrowed from Russian микробиология (mikrobiologija). By surface analysis, mikro- + biologiya.
